context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 11:58 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (notes): coordinator 12:10 CST Nov 12, from its list of today's picks.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: Any run on the base branch already proves the red came before the PR.
options.how: When a check is red before a PR touched it, any run on any commit of the base branch counts as proof (PR #2826). This replaces an older coordinator line from Nov 8 that asked for the merge base's own run.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: Only the merge base's own run counts.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The governed work is redone or waits for the change.

reply: Reversed 13:19 CST after the retrospective's audit: no ruling backed it, and it was unsound. The proof run must be on the base branch and no older than the pull request's merge base. Step base-hash-on-base builds that; PR #2826 holds until it lands.
